pipelines.name: Platform Test

steps.name: List tests
steps.run:
allTests=$(find . -name test-plan.yaml -exec dirname {} \; | sed -e "s/^\.\///g" | jq --raw-input --slurp --compact-output 'split("\n") | map(select(. != ""))')
manualOnlyTests=$(find . -name .manual-only -type f -exec dirname {} \; | sed "s|^\./||" | jq --raw-input --slurp --compact-output 'split("\n") | map(select(. != ""))')
if [ "${{ github.event_name }}" == "pull_request" ]; then
  # Filter out labels that don't start with "platform-test-" and remove the prefix
  chosenTests=$(echo "${LABELS}" | jq --raw-output --compact-output '[.[] | select(startswith("platform-test-")) | sub("^platform-test-"; "")]')

  # Always run the Instrumentation Hub tests when this PR changes the chart version.
  baseVersion=$(git show "${BASE_SHA}:charts/k8s-monitoring/Chart.yaml" 2>/dev/null | yq eval '.version' - || true)
  headVersion=$(yq eval '.version' ../../Chart.yaml)
  echo "Chart version: base='${baseVersion}' head='${headVersion}'"
  if [ -n "${headVersion}" ] && [ "${baseVersion}" != "${headVersion}" ]; then
    echo "Chart version changed; forcing Instrumentation Hub tests to run."
    ihubTests=$(jq --null-input --compact-output --argjson allTests "${allTests}" '$allTests | map(select(startswith("grafana-cloud/ihub")))')
    chosenTests=$(jq --null-input --compact-output --argjson chosen "${chosenTests}" --argjson ihub "${ihubTests}" '$chosen + $ihub | unique')
  fi

  # Choose the tests that match the labels
  tests=$(jq --null-input --compact-output --argjson allTests "${allTests}" --argjson chosenTests "${chosenTests}" '$allTests | map(select(. as $test | $chosenTests | index($test)))')
else
  tests=${allTests}
fi

# remove manual only tests
tests=$(jq --null-input --compact-output --argjson tests "${tests}" --argjson manualOnlyTests "${manualOnlyTests}" '$tests | map(select(. as $test | $manualOnlyTests | index($test) | not))')

echo "Tests: ${tests}"
echo "tests=${tests}" >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"

pipelines.name: Release Helm chart

steps.name: Parse Chart.yaml
Extract release notes from CHANGELOG
steps.run:
changelog="charts/k8s-monitoring/CHANGELOG.md"
notes_file="${RUNNER_TEMP}/release_notes.md"

# Build the list of headers to try, in order:
#   - the full version (e.g. "4.0.5")
#   - the version with a trailing ".0" stripped (e.g. "4.1" for "4.1.0"),
#     since the changelog sometimes drops the patch component on .0 releases
candidates=("${VERSION}")
if [[ "${VERSION}" == *.0 ]]; then
  candidates+=("${VERSION%.0}")
fi

extract() {
  awk -v ver="$1" '
    /^## / {
      if (found) exit
      header = $0
      sub(/^##[[:space:]]+/, "", header)
      if (header == ver) { found = 1; next }
      next
    }
    found { print }
  ' "$changelog"
}

body=""
for candidate in "${candidates[@]}"; do
  body=$(extract "$candidate")
  # Trim leading/trailing blank lines for the emptiness check
  trimmed=$(printf '%s' "$body" | sed -e '/./,$!d' | tac | sed -e '/./,$!d' | tac)
  if [[ -n "$trimmed" ]]; then
    body="$trimmed"
    echo "Matched changelog section '## ${candidate}'"
    break
  fi
  body=""
done

if [[ -z "$body" ]]; then
  echo "::warning::No CHANGELOG.md section found for version ${VERSION}; falling back to a generic note."
  body="See [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/blob/${TAGNAME}/charts/k8s-monitoring/CHANGELOG.md) for details."
fi

{
  echo "## What's changed"
  echo
  echo "$body"
  echo
  echo "---"
  echo
  echo "Chart released at https://github.com/grafana/helm-charts/releases/tag/${TAGNAME}"
  echo
  echo "Full changelog: [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/blob/${TAGNAME}/charts/k8s-monitoring/CHANGELOG.md)"
} > "$notes_file"

echo "notes_path=${notes_file}" >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"
echo "----- Release notes -----"
cat "$notes_file"
echo "-------------------------"

steps.name: Make GitHub release
steps.run:
prerelease_flag=""
if [[ "${PRERELEASE}" == "true" ]]; then
  prerelease_flag="--prerelease"
fi
gh release create "${TAGNAME}" \
  --title "${TAGNAME}" \
  --repo "${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}" \
  --notes-file "${NOTES_PATH}" \
  ${prerelease_flag}

pipelines.name: Unit Test

steps.name: Detect Changed Charts
steps.run:
if [ "${{ github.event_name }}" == "pull_request" ]; then
  # In pull request, compare against the base branch (upstream)
  echo "Comparing against base branch: ${BASE_BRANCH}"
  git fetch origin "${BASE_BRANCH}"
  base_commit="origin/${BASE_BRANCH}"
elif [ "${{ github.event_name }}" == "push" ]; then
  # In push to main, compare the last commit with HEAD^
  base_commit="HEAD^"
elif [ "${{ github.event_name }}" == "workflow_dispatch" ]; then
  # In manual trigger, run for all charts
  echo "Manual dispatch detected, running tests for all charts"
  # shellcheck disable=SC2010
  changed_charts=$(ls charts | grep -v "k8s-monitoring-v1" | sort -u)
  echo "changed_charts=$(echo "$changed_charts" | jq --raw-input --slurp --compact-output 'split("\n") | map(select(. != ""))')" >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"
  exit 0
fi

# Check if base commit exists, fallback to empty tree if none
if ! git rev-parse --verify "$base_commit" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  base_commit=$(git hash-object -t tree /dev/null)
fi

# Detect modified files
modified_charts=$(git diff --name-only "$base_commit" HEAD -- 'charts/*' | grep "^charts/" | cut -d "/" -f2 | sort -u)

# Detect newly added files (untracked files)
added_charts=$(git ls-files --others --exclude-standard -- 'charts/*' | grep "^charts/" | cut -d "/" -f2 | sort -u)

# Combine both added and modified charts
changed_charts=$(echo -e "$modified_charts\n$added_charts" | grep -v "k8s-monitoring-v1" | sort -u)

if [ -z "$changed_charts" ]; then
  echo "No changes detected in charts"
  echo "changed_charts=none" >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"
else
  echo "Changed charts: $changed_charts"
  echo "changed_charts=$(echo "$changed_charts" | jq --raw-input --slurp --compact-output 'split("\n") | map(select(. != ""))')" >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"
fi
